---
title: "cache.iscached"
sidebarTitle: "cache.iscached"
description: "Returns whether the given Instance has a non-nil entry in the Instance cache."
keywords: ["cache.iscached","Cache"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
cache.iscached(instance: Instance): boolean
```

## Arguments

<ParamField path={"instance"} type={"Instance"} required>
Instance whose Instance cache entry should be checked.
</ParamField>

## Returns

<ResponseField name={"cached"} type={"boolean"}>
True when the cache contains a non-nil entry for the Instance.
</ResponseField>

## Example

Check whether an Instance currently has an entry in Real's Instance cache.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local cached = cache.iscached(Players)
print(cached)

cache.invalidate(Players)
print(cache.iscached(Players))
```


</div>
